rows.grounds: name of the seal; from root kṛṣ with prefix ā
gerundive indicating what must be recognized
indicates consequence or sequence in that context
compound bhuvana+āraka; locative indicating the locus

items.question: Which seal must be recognized as operative within the world-wheel?
premises: A seal is specified in this context.
That seal is identified as ākarṣiṇī, the attracting one.
Its recognition is located within the world-wheel.
items.inference: The ākarṣiṇī seal is the one to be known in the world-wheel.
uncertainties: The precise referent of bhuvanāraka in this ritual context is not fully specified.
items.plain_english: And the seal to be known there in the world-wheel is indeed the attracting seal.
